description: Department of Census and Statistics - The Colombo Consumers' Price Index for the Month of July 2015 was 182.00
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the Colombo Consumers' Price Index for July 2015, which is statistical economic data published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any specialized categories (Types 4-9) such as land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. This falls under general administrative/statistical announcements, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
